An [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] '''planet''' was the site of a [[Battle of unidentified Outer Rim planet|battle]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
